justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinter.java` at the `TwoDigitYearField` declaration (lines 723-758) and its call site in `parsePattern()` (lines 1365-1369). This nested class is `private static final`, has a singleton `INSTANCE`, and only implements three tiny behaviors: format a `Calendar.YEAR` value to two digits, format an int with `% 100`, and report fixed length `2`. It serves one narrow responsibility for `y/Y` patterns and shows no evidence of multiple responsibilities, large method count, or separable concerns, so insufficient modularization is not present.
